messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #27133 (service-auth) is green locally but linux-integration is stuck in the queue (ETA ~30m). We have the deploy freeze tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Can we shift this merge into the night window (00:00–02:00 UTC) to avoid blocking the release? pinging @mira @ryan for quick eyes

mira: I can take a look now. Seems small from the overview but will need a tiny rebase on main (conflicting import). If it's just that I can approve after a quick pass.

ryan: On my way — should be able to review in ~30m. If we plan a night merge + canary, i'm fine with it.

ci-bot: ci-triage: job linux-integration queued (position 12). Estimated start: ~28m.

alex: If we rebase now will that bump the job back in queue? Trying to estimate risk.

tammy: Prefer we don't land before the freeze. Night window is fine, but we need the feature behind a canary flag and a 10% rollout. Also need infra to reserve a slot.

alex: Will add the flag and push the rebase. Plan: get approvals, push rebase branch `pr/27133-rebase-night`, and schedule merge at 00:15 UTC with canary 10%.

mira: +1 on code. Left one tiny comment about log text, non-blocking.

ryan: Reviewed and approved. Rebase pushed: `git push origin pr/27133-rebase-night` — CI should pick it up.

ci-bot: ci-run: linux-integration started (run id: 89234).

alex: Thanks. @tammy can you confirm canary +10% is good? Also, @infra-team can you hold one extra linux runner for 00:00–02:00 UTC so we don't get queued back into the morning rush?

tammy: Canary +10% — approved.

infra-team: Allocated one extra runner for 00:00–02:00 UTC and tagged it `night-window-00-02`.

alex: Scheduling merge now — will use the scheduled merge command: `/merge --at 00:15UTC pr/27133-rebase-night --canary=10%` and I'll monitor logs.

deploy-bot: scheduled merge: pr 27133 at 00:15 UTC. Auto-retry policy: 2 retries on transient CI failures, manual revert on regression.

ryan: If linux-integration flakes, let's not spam retries; prefer one retry then manual triage.

alex: Agreed — will set retries to 1 and escalate to on-call if failure. Thanks everyone, i'll post back with outcome after midnight.

mira: I'll keep eyes on canary after it lands. Good plan. :thumbsup:

alex: (follow-up) Rebase changed queue position but the reserved runner ensured start within 10m of midnight. Will update after merge.
